headline.purpose: Page title in the sticky header, and the date on the home record.

field.purpose: Input, select, and textarea text. 16px so a phone does not zoom on focus.

meta.purpose: Captions, tab counts, and status chips. The 12px floor.

motion.name: color
motion.purpose: Row and control color changes. Spinners stop under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one marigold action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8f5413; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #744314; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8f5413; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet action beside the primary, such as Cancel or Refresh.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #334155; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8f5413; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled field. Type is 16px so a phone does not zoom on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #1b1e1d; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; caret-color: #8f5413; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #475569; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8f5413; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #8f5413; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A gate status. The word carries the meaning; the tint repeats it.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 10px; }

components.description: A white record on the paper page.

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky bar: mark, title, and one disclosure for secondary links.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f2f3f1; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-header-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff; color: #334155; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8f5413; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
House Prefect Affairs is the book the house opens every morning. The page is cool paper, the record is ink, and marigold appears only when someone has to act: sign in, save attendance, add a prefect. Density is operational. A screen is a table, a short set of tabs, and one primary button, not a marketing composition.

The system was taken from the incumbent implementation: Archivo for the interface, IBM Plex Mono for PINs, times, and codes, slate for structure, and the marigold ramp for the single accent. This pass darkened the action fill so white labels clear WCAG AA, and it set 12px as the smallest text.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper, white sheets, hairline rules
One accent, used on the action and on the active tab underline
Status is a word plus a tint, never a color alone
Mono is for data, not for decoration
Touch targets on phones are at least 44px; desktop headers may sit slightly tighter

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Marigold fills a control the person is about to press. It does not fill cards, page backgrounds, or large decorative regions.

rules.name: The Readable Record Rule
rules.body: Any fact a prefect's name depends on (PIN, class, code, time) uses caption slate or darker. Disabled controls may be lighter; they are the exception.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: 12px is the floor. Saved, Late, and role badges use the meta size, not 10px.

rules.name: The Phone Reach Rule
rules.body: Header triggers, row actions (Excuse, Delete, Edit), dialog close, and the password reveal control are at least 44px tall on small screens. From 768px up, header icon buttons may return to 36px.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: The page itself has no shadow and no gradient. A shadow means the surface is floating over the ledger for a moment.

dos: Do use marigold ink (`#8f5413`) for a primary button that carries white text.
Do put PINs, class, and codes in caption slate (`#475569`) or darker, at 12px or larger.
Do keep status as a word on a tinted chip.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for device data and codes.
Do scroll a long tab row instead of crushing the labels.
donts: Don't put white text on the lighter marigold (`#b56d15`). It fails 4.5:1.
Don't use type smaller than 12px for a badge, count, or caption.
Don't build a second dialog out of a fixed overlay. Use the shared dialog.
Don't name a delete control with only "×" or an unlabeled icon.
Don't spend marigold on decoration. One action per region.
